name: stage_hand_tuned_2026_06_03
description:
Live observation 2026-06-03 — Joseph reported emergent gait-like properties from G6DOF compliant body under THIS reward+spring config, with NO Cruse components and ALL walking-shaping rewards set to zero (gated_walk_bonus_rate=0, phase_contrast_gain=0, gait_cycle_reward_gain=0, per_leg_credit_gain=0, progress_reward_gain=0, level_chassis_rate=0, height_penalty_gain=0). The body's own springs + motor freeplay surface rhythm under standing-only reward.

Differences from picrawler_g6dof_compliant_stand_handtuned: stiffer hip1 (8.0→9.0, damping 1.5→1.8), stiffer hip2 (7.0→7.5) with LESS damping (1.5→0.75 — load-bearing for the bounce), stiffer knee (7.0→7.5), added motor_freeplay_rad=0.1, dropped reward_min_height (0.03→0.02), zeroed height_penalty_gain (0.05→0.0). New families: gait_cycle_* params + bri_* params present (preserved exactly from Joseph's capture).

RESERVED PURPOSE: this is the Stage 0 reproducibility reference for the Premotor active-inference upgrade on the G6DOF substrate (plan: docs/plans-and-designs/premotor_active_inference_upgrade.md once promoted). Stage 0 = run this with the shipped Premotor, no EFE, to lock the emergent-rhythm baseline before any brain-side change.
